input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that the increase in Tesla's operating expenses in 2025 was driven primarily by AI-related research and development. Operating expenses consist of R&D and SG&A expenses. Evidence E2 shows R&D expense increased $1.87 billion (41%) in 2025 vs 2024, "primarily due to increases in costs related to AI and other programs." Evidence E5 shows SG&A increased $684 million (13%) in the same period. The R&D increase ($1.87B) is significantly larger than the SG&A increase ($684M), and the filing explicitly attributes the R&D increase primarily to AI-related costs. This supports the claim that AI-related R&D was the primary driver of the overall operating expense increase. Evidence E4 provides corroborating information for the nine-month period showing the same pattern and attribution to AI.
